fusions.name: Dart on a Tether
fusions.desc: Whips a tethered dart at a target up to 6 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and the line slows it by 30% for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Lockstitch
fusions.desc: Sends a threaded spike into the first enemy it meets for 11 damage and stuns it for 0.8 seconds. It then passes on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Pulled Taut
fusions.desc: Draws a line 5 tiles long tight around a point ahead of you for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Slack Taken Up
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 7% more damage per stack (33% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
